title: CAMERA:
content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself, occasionally propping it on a bench/rack. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.
LOOK:
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights under gym lighting, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones.
STYLE:
Energetic, casual gym-vlog tone — upbeat between sets, breathless, genuine laughs, light motivational commentary. Quick handheld cuts alternating with propped-camera shots.
Character
CHASE — Korean idol, 20s. Long black hair in a high ponytail, glowing skin with light post-workout sheen. Slim athletic build. Modest long-sleeve athletic top, loose joggers/leggings (arms and torso fully covered), sneakers, towel around neck, no jewelry.
Setting
Evening gym — mirror wall, weight rack, bench press station, leg curl machine nearby, water bottle on a bench, soft overhead lighting.
Storyboard (30s, 8 cuts)
(~2s, selfie, arm's length) Walks in, bright smile despite slight breathlessness. CHASE: "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2s, whip pan) Sweeps weight rack → mirror → mat area, back to her face. CHASE (off-screen): "Gym's pretty quiet right now."
(~3s, propped camera, bench press) Lies back, adjusts grip, glances at camera, determined smile. CHASE: "Bench press time — let's go!"
(~3s, propped camera, side angle) Performs a few reps, breathing hard, racks the bar, exhales. CHASE: "Whew — that's the set."
(~2s, handheld walking) Grabs towel/water, walks toward leg curl machine, camera bouncing. CHASE: "Moving on to legs now."
(~3s, propped camera, leg curl) Settles in, adjusts pad, a couple reps, mild strain on her face. CHASE: "Okay this one burns already—"
(~2s, macro insert, shallow DOF) Close on hands gripping machine handles, sweat catching the light. No dialogue — ambient gym sound only.
(~3s, arm's-length selfie finish) Stands, fans herself, towel on shoulder, tired grin. CHASE: "Two down — I need water. See you guys in a bit!"

es.content:
CAMARA:
Sensación de cámara de mano con videocámara DV de cinta de 16 mm. POV de CHASE sosteniendo ella misma la cámara, apoyándola ocasionalmente en un banco/soporte. Temblor de mano, encuadre desalineado, focus pulls retrasados, zooms torpes, encuadres ocasionalmente cortando parte del rostro, tomas imperfectas. La videocámara nunca aparece en pantalla.
LOOK:
Calidad de cinta suave, ligeramente borrosa, leve ruido de cinta, highlights reventados bajo la iluminación del gimnasio, autoexposición parpadeante, contraste apagado, tonos de piel realistas.
STYLE:
Tono enérgico y casual de vlog de gimnasio — animado entre series, jadeante, risas genuinas, comentarios motivacionales ligeros. Cortes rápidos en mano alternando con tomas con la cámara apoyada.
Character
CHASE — ídolo coreana, 20s. Cabello largo negro en una coleta alta, piel luminosa con un ligero brillo post-entrenamiento. Complexión atlética y delgada. Top deportivo modesto de manga larga, joggers/leggings holgados (brazos y torso completamente cubiertos), zapatillas, toalla alrededor del cuello, sin joyas.
Setting
Gimnasio por la tarde — pared de espejos, rack de pesas, estación de press de banca, máquina de curl de piernas cerca, botella de agua sobre un banco, iluminación suave desde arriba.
Storyboard (30s, 8 cuts)
(~2s, selfie, a la distancia del brazo) Entra caminando, sonrisa brillante pese a la ligera falta de aire. CHASE: "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2s, whip pan) Barre rack de pesas → espejo → zona de colchonetas, vuelve a su rostro. CHASE (off-screen): "Gym's pretty quiet right now."
(~3s, cámara apoyada, press de banca) Se recuesta, ajusta el agarre, mira a la cámara, sonrisa decidida. CHASE: "Bench press time — let's go!"
(~3s, cámara apoyada, ángulo lateral) Hace unas cuantas repeticiones, respirando con fuerza, vuelve a colocar la barra en el rack, exhala. CHASE: "Whew — that's the set."
(~2s, caminando con la cámara en mano) Coge la toalla/agua, camina hacia la máquina de curl de piernas, la cámara rebota. CHASE: "Moving on to legs now."
(~3s, cámara apoyada, curl de piernas) Se acomoda, ajusta la almohadilla, un par de repeticiones, leve gesto de esfuerzo en el rostro. CHASE: "Okay this one burns already—"
(~2s, inserto macro, poca profundidad de campo) Primer plano de las manos agarrando las asas de la máquina, el sudor captando la luz. Sin diálogo — solo sonido ambiente del gimnasio.
(~3s, selfie final a la distancia del brazo) Se pone de pie, se abanica, toalla sobre el hombro, sonrisa cansada. CHASE: "Two down — I need water. See you guys in a bit!"

fr.content:
CAMÉRA :
Caméscope DV 16 mm, sensation de prise de vue à la main. POV de CHASE tenant elle-même la caméra, la posant parfois sur un banc/une barre. Tremblements de la main, cadrage désaligné, mises au point retardées, zooms maladroits, cadrage coupant parfois le visage, plans imparfaits. Le caméscope n’apparaît jamais à l’écran.

LOOK :
Qualité de bande douce, légèrement floue, léger bruit de bande, hautes lumières qui débordent sous l’éclairage de la salle, auto-exposition vacillante, contraste atténué, tons de peau réalistes.

STYLE :
Ton énergique et décontracté de vlog de salle de sport — dynamique entre les séries, essoufflé, rires authentiques, commentaires motivants légers. Coups de caméra rapides à la main alternant avec des plans caméra posée.

Character
CHASE — idole coréenne, vingtaine. Longs cheveux noirs en queue de cheval haute, peau lumineuse avec une légère brillance post-entraînement. Silhouette athlétique fine. Haut de sport modeste à manches longues, jogging/legging ample (bras et torse entièrement couverts), baskets, serviette autour du cou, aucun bijou.

Setting
Salle de sport en soirée — mur de miroirs, rack de poids, station de développé couché, machine à leg curl à proximité, bouteille d’eau sur un banc, éclairage doux au plafond.

Storyboard (30 s, 8 plans)
(~2 s, selfie, à bout de bras) Entre en marchant, grand sourire malgré un léger essoufflement. CHASE : "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2 s, whip pan) Balaye rack de poids → miroir → zone de tapis, puis retour sur son visage. CHASE (hors champ) : "Gym's pretty quiet right now."
(~3 s, caméra posée, développé couché) S’allonge, ajuste sa prise, jette un coup d’œil à la caméra, sourire déterminé. CHASE : "Bench press time — let's go!"
(~3 s, caméra posée, angle latéral) Effectue quelques répétitions, respire fort, repose la barre, expire. CHASE : "Whew — that's the set."
(~2 s, marche caméra à la main) Attrape serviette/eau, se dirige vers la machine à leg curl, caméra qui rebondit. CHASE : "Moving on to legs now."
(~3 s, caméra posée, leg curl) S’installe, ajuste le coussin, quelques répétitions, légère grimace d’effort sur le visage. CHASE : "Okay this one burns already—"
(~2 s, insert macro, faible profondeur de champ) Gros plan sur les mains agrippant les poignées de la machine, la sueur captant la lumière. Aucun dialogue — seulement le son ambiant de la salle.
(~3 s, selfie final à bout de bras) Se lève, s’évente, serviette sur l’épaule, sourire fatigué. CHASE : "Two down — I need water. See you guys in a bit!"

ja.content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mmテープのビデオカメラを手持ちで撮ったような質感。CHASE本人がカメラを持っているPOVで、時々ベンチやラックに立てかける。手ブレ、フレーミングのズレ、遅れて入るフォーカス送り、不器用なズーム、たまに顔が切れる構図、完璧ではないショット。ビデオカメラ本体は画面に映らない。
LOOK:
柔らかく、ややぼやけたテープ質感、かすかなテープノイズ、ジム照明でハイライトがにじむ感じ、ちらつくオート露出、抑えめのコントラスト、自然な肌色。
STYLE:
エネルギッシュでカジュアルなジムVlogのトーン — セット間は明るく、息を切らしながらも自然な笑い、軽いモチベーション系のコメント。手持ちの素早いカットと、カメラを置いたショットを交互に切り替える。
Character
CHASE — 韓国のアイドル、20代。長い黒髪を高いポニーテールにまとめ、運動後の軽いツヤを帯びた輝く肌。細身でアスレチックな体型。控えめな長袖のアスレチックトップ、ゆったりしたジョガーパンツ／レギンス（腕と胴体は完全に覆う）、スニーカー、首にタオル、アクセサリーなし。
Setting
夕方のジム — 鏡張りの壁、ウェイトラック、ベンチプレス台、近くにレッグカールマシン、ベンチの上に水筒、柔らかな天井照明。
Storyboard (30s, 8 cuts)
(~2s, selfie, arm's length) 入ってきて、少し息が上がっているのに明るい笑顔。CHASE: "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2s, whip pan) ウェイトラック → 鏡 → マットエリアへと素早く振り、彼女の顔に戻る。CHASE (off-screen): "Gym's pretty quiet right now."
(~3s, propped camera, bench press) 仰向けになり、グリップを調整し、カメラをちらっと見て、決意のこもった笑顔。CHASE: "Bench press time — let's go!"
(~3s, propped camera, side angle) 数回レップをこなし、息を切らしながらバーをラックに戻し、息を吐く。CHASE: "Whew — that's the set."
(~2s, handheld walking) タオル／水を取り、レッグカールマシンへ向かって歩く。カメラは揺れる。CHASE: "Moving on to legs now."
(~3s, propped camera, leg curl) 位置を整え、パッドを調整し、数回レップ。顔に軽いきつさが出る。CHASE: "Okay this one burns already—"
(~2s, macro insert, shallow DOF) マシンのハンドルを握る手のクローズアップ。汗が光を受けてきらめく。セリフなし — 環境音のみ。
(~3s, arm's-length selfie finish) 立ち上がって自分をあおぎ、肩にタオルをかけ、疲れた笑み。CHASE: "Two down — I need water. See you guys in a bit!"

ko.content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm 테이프 캠코더의 핸드헬드 느낌. CHASE가 직접 카메라를 들고 있는 POV이며, 가끔 벤치/랙 위에 올려둔다. 손떨림, 어긋난 구도, 늦게 따라오는 포커스 풀, 서툰 줌, 가끔 얼굴이 잘리는 프레이밍, 완벽하지 않은 샷. 캠코더는 화면에 절대 등장하지 않는다.
LOOK:
부드럽고 약간 흐릿한 테이프 화질, 희미한 테이프 노이즈, 체육관 조명 아래에서 번지는 하이라이트, 깜빡이는 자동 노출, 절제된 대비, 자연스러운 피부 톤.
STYLE:
에너지 넘치고 캐주얼한 짐 브이로그 톤 — 세트 사이에는 경쾌하게, 숨이 차는 와중에도 진솔한 웃음, 가벼운 동기부여 멘트. 손으로 빠르게 찍는 컷과 카메라를 올려둔 샷이 번갈아 이어짐.
Character
CHASE — 한국 아이돌, 20대. 긴 검은 머리를 높게 묶은 포니테일, 운동 후 은은한 윤기가 도는 맑은 피부. 슬림한 운동 체형. 단정한 긴소매 운동 상의, 헐렁한 조거 팬츠/레깅스(팔과 몸통은 완전히 가려짐), 스니커즈, 목에 걸친 수건, 액세서리 없음.
Setting
저녁 시간의 체육관 — 거울 벽, 웨이트 랙, 벤치프레스 스테이션, 옆에 레그 컬 머신, 벤치 위 물병, 부드러운 천장 조명.
Storyboard (30s, 8 cuts)
(~2s, 셀피, 팔 길이) 들어오며 약간 숨이 찬 상태에도 환하게 웃는다. CHASE: "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2s, 휩 팬) 웨이트 랙 → 거울 → 매트 구역을 훑고 다시 그녀의 얼굴로 돌아온다. CHASE (화면 밖): "Gym's pretty quiet right now."
(~3s, 카메라를 올려둔 샷, 벤치프레스) 등을 대고 눕고, 그립을 조정한 뒤 카메라를 힐끗 보며 결연하게 웃는다. CHASE: "Bench press time — let's go!"
(~3s, 카메라를 올려둔 샷, 측면 앵글) 몇 회 반복하고, 숨을 거칠게 내쉬며 바를 랙에 걸고 숨을 내쉰다. CHASE: "Whew — that's the set."
(~2s, 핸드헬드 워킹) 수건/물을 집어 들고 레그 컬 머신 쪽으로 걸어가며 카메라가 흔들린다. CHASE: "Moving on to legs now."
(~3s, 카메라를 올려둔 샷, 레그 컬) 자리를 잡고 패드를 조정한 뒤 몇 회 반복, 얼굴에 약간의 힘이 들어간다. CHASE: "Okay this one burns already—"
(~2s, 매크로 인서트, 얕은 심도) 머신 손잡이를 쥔 손 클로즈업, 땀이 빛을 받는다. 대사 없음 — 주변 체육관 소리만.
(~3s, 팔 길이 셀피 마무리) 일어서서 손부채질을 하고, 수건을 어깨에 걸친 채 지친 미소를 짓는다. CHASE: "Two down — I need water. See you guys in a bit!"

pt.content:
CÂMERA:
Sensação de camcorder DV em fita 16mm, filmado à mão. POV de CHASE segurando a câmera ela mesma, às vezes apoiando-a em um banco/suporte. Tremor de mão, enquadramento desalinhado, ajustes de foco atrasados, zooms desajeitados, enquadramentos ocasionais cortando o rosto, takes imperfeitos. A camcorder nunca aparece em cena.
VISUAL:
Qualidade suave, levemente borrada, com aparência de fita, leve ruído de tape, highlights estourados sob a iluminação da academia, autoexposição oscilando, contraste suave, tons de pele realistas.
ESTILO:
Tom energético e casual de vlog de academia — animado entre as séries, ofegante, risadas genuínas, comentários leves de motivação. Cortes rápidos na mão alternando com takes com a câmera apoiada.
Personagem
CHASE — idol coreana, 20 e poucos anos. Cabelo preto longo em rabo de cavalo alto, pele luminosa com leve brilho pós-treino. Corpo atlético e esguio. Top esportivo de manga longa e discreto, joggers/leggings folgados (braços e torso totalmente cobertos), tênis, toalha no pescoço, sem joias.
Cenário
Academia à noite — parede espelhada, rack de pesos, estação de supino, máquina de leg curl por perto, garrafa de água em um banco, iluminação suave no teto.
Storyboard (30s, 8 cortes)
(~2s, selfie, braço estendido) Entra andando, sorriso brilhante apesar da leve falta de ar. CHASE: "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2s, whip pan) Varre o rack de pesos → espelho → área do colchonete, volta para o rosto dela. CHASE (off-screen): "Gym's pretty quiet right now."
(~3s, câmera apoiada, supino) Deita, ajusta a pegada, olha para a câmera, sorriso determinado. CHASE: "Bench press time — let's go!"
(~3s, câmera apoiada, ângulo lateral) Faz algumas repetições, respirando forte, recoloca a barra no suporte, solta o ar. CHASE: "Whew — that's the set."
(~2s, andando com a câmera na mão) Pega a toalha/água, vai em direção à máquina de leg curl, câmera balançando. CHASE: "Moving on to legs now."
(~3s, câmera apoiada, leg curl) Se acomoda, ajusta a almofada, faz algumas repetições, expressão de leve esforço. CHASE: "Okay this one burns already—"
(~2s, insert macro, profundidade de campo rasa) Close nas mãos segurando as alças da máquina, suor refletindo a luz. Sem diálogo — apenas som ambiente da academia.
(~3s, selfie final com braço estendido) Fica de pé, se abana, toalha no ombro, sorriso cansado. CHASE: "Two down — I need water. See you guys in a bit!"

zh.content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm 磁带摄像机的手持感。CHASE 自己拿着相机的 POV，偶尔把它架在长凳/器械架上。画面有手部晃动、构图不对位、对焦延迟、笨拙的变焦、偶尔脸部被切掉的构图，以及不完美的镜头。摄像机始终不出现在画面中。
LOOK:
柔和、略微模糊的磁带画质，轻微磁带噪点，健身房灯光下高光泛白，自动曝光闪烁，低饱和对比度，真实肤色。
STYLE:
充满活力、轻松随性的健身 vlog 语气——组间语调轻快、气喘吁吁、真诚的笑声、带一点鼓励性的轻松评论。快速的手持切换与架机位镜头交替出现。
Character
CHASE — 韩国偶像，20 多岁。黑色长发扎成高马尾，皮肤发亮，带着轻微运动后的光泽。身材纤细、运动感强。穿着朴素的长袖运动上衣、宽松慢跑裤/紧身裤（手臂和躯干完全遮住）、运动鞋，脖子上搭着毛巾，没有首饰。
Setting
傍晚的健身房——镜墙、哑铃架、卧推区、旁边有腿弯举机，长凳上放着水瓶，柔和的顶灯。
Storyboard (30s, 8 cuts)
(~2s, 自拍，手臂长度) 走进来，虽然有点喘，仍然笑得很灿烂。CHASE: "Okay guys, quick workout vlog today!"
(~2s, 快速摇镜) 扫过哑铃架 → 镜子 → 垫子区域，再回到她的脸。CHASE（画外）: "Gym's pretty quiet right now."
(~3s, 架机位，卧推) 躺下，调整握距，看向镜头，露出坚定的微笑。CHASE: "Bench press time — let's go!"
(~3s, 架机位，侧面角度) 做了几次重复，呼吸急促，把杠铃放回架上，长呼一口气。CHASE: "Whew — that's the set."
(~2s, 手持行走) 拿起毛巾/水，朝腿弯举机走去，镜头轻轻晃动。CHASE: "Moving on to legs now."
(~3s, 架机位，腿弯举) 坐稳，调整垫子，做了几次重复，脸上带着轻微吃力的表情。CHASE: "Okay this one burns already—"
(~2s, 微距插入，浅景深) 特写双手握住器械把手，汗水在灯光下闪闪发亮。无对白——只有环境中的健身房声音。
(~3s, 手臂长度自拍收尾) 站起来，用手给自己扇风，毛巾搭在肩上，疲惫地咧嘴一笑。CHASE: "Two down — I need water. See you guys in a bit!"
